correctness.rationale: The complete lower-bound proof constructs t pairwise-disjoint subsets A-A and z_i-A of any host group, each of cardinality at least M. The cyclic upper host of order tM has S=Gamma\H. At equality |A-A|=M forces A a coset of subgroup H, and the forced edge and nonedge differences yield S=Gamma\H and the unique coset placement. All hypotheses, zero/nonzero differences, t=2, singleton parts, and arbitrary finite abelian groups are covered. Exact verifier tests 456 constructions, 55,420 vertex pairs and 55,944 candidate normalized embeddings in 19 small abelian group types; the finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: Fokam Souop–Bitjoka Remark 12 proves only the upper bound and expressly leaves unbalanced complete multipartite induced abelian hosts undetermined. A publicly recorded K_{1,1,n} exact lower bound is a strict special case, credited and excluded as a separate contribution. Akhtar–Evans–Pritikin force a cyclic unit-connection host and study another invariant. The full t arbitrary positive part sizes theorem plus optimal-host rigidity do not follow from the inspected statements alone. Residual risk is uncatalogued equivalent formulations.
residual_risks: A differently titled or uncatalogued result may already imply the universal tM lower bound or optimal-host rigidity; literature noncoverage is not proof of global novelty.
